title: A credit union service organisation designs itself a purpose trust — 'The goal is to make it so I cannot be.'
summary: Brownell lists five CUSOs whose missions eroded after their credit union owners sold — USERS, Prime Alliance, CUSO Financial Services, Safe Harbor and Bonifii — and argues that credit union ownership alone locks nothing. He credits Eric for the design he is now applying at CUCollaborate: a purpose trust holding control for one beneficiary, consumers' financial benefit, measured and published yearly.
blockquote: Until it is, the honest description of my company is an innovative mission focused CUSO with a well intentioned founder who controls the vote (but is still corruptible). The goal is to make it so I cannot be.
